title: RouteCandidate
description:
One scored payment route considered by the RoutePlanner (SPEC §5.2, §6.4).

A candidate is produced for every requirement that has both an enabled scheme handler and a configured signer. Non-viable candidates are retained rather than dropped, with their `rejectionReasons` populated, so that InsufficientLiquidityError can report per-network deficits and so that route decisions are explainable in diagnostics.

Ordering is fully determined by SPEC §6.4 step 18 and MUST be identical for identical inputs and health state.

requirementIndex.description: Index into NormalizedPaymentRequired.requirements. The final, stable tie-break in route ordering.

network.description: Canonical CAIP-2. Health indexing and policy matching key on this, never on an alias (ADR-010 decision 4).

assetId.description: CAIP-19, derived from the network and the offered asset address/mint.

signerId.description: Stable, non-secret identifier for the signer that would authorize this route — `evm:<address>` or `solana:<pubkey>`. Public identifiers only; never key material (SEC-003). Absent when no configured signer can serve the requirement.

balanceAtomic.description: Observed spendable balance of `assetId` for `signerId`. Absent when the balance query failed or timed out (600 ms per provider, max 2 providers per network — SPEC §6.4 step 15); an absent balance makes the candidate non-viable, it does not make it zero.

estimatedFeeAtomic.description: Expected buyer-borne fee in atomic units of `assetId`. `"0"` for the exact scheme on both supported networks in v0.1, where the merchant bears settlement cost.

healthScore.description: Local EWMA health for this network's endpoints. New endpoints start at 0.80 (SPEC §6.4 step 17). Derived only from locally observed outcomes — never from remote telemetry (SEC-010).

observedLatencyMs.description: EWMA latency (alpha 0.20) for this network's endpoints. Ordering tie-break below healthScore.

circuitState.description: An open endpoint may be selected only when every compatible endpoint is open, and it is then ranked last (SPEC §6.5).

rank.description: 1-based position after ordering. Assigned to every candidate including non-viable ones, so diagnostics show the full considered set.

viable.description: True when balanceAtomic >= amountAtomic and the signer can authorize this asset/scheme (SPEC §6.4 step 16). Viable candidates always sort ahead of non-viable ones.

rejectionReasons.description: Empty exactly when `viable` is true. Machine-readable and redaction-safe: no balances beyond the atomic figures already in this object, no addresses beyond `signerId`.

allOf.description: A viable candidate has no rejection reasons, and vice versa.
Viability is only assertable when a signer and a balance were both resolved.
